responsibility: Defines the trait query submodule namespace, grouping canonical-query support for obligation evaluation, normalization, dropck, method autoderef, and type operations, and re-exporting the shared query interface types from `rustc_middle`.
same_name_distinction: Among the `traits/*/mod.rs` files, this one is the namespace root for canonical trait queries. It primarily groups query submodules and re-exports shared query interfaces from `rustc_middle`, whereas `traits/query/type_op/mod.rs` implements one concrete query-backed framework and modules like `select` or `specialize` contain operational logic.
